quests.title: Something To Build With
quests.description: You won't last the week with what's in your pockets. <LINE> Bring me the basics and we'll talk about the work that pays.

quests.title: Thinning The Herd
quests.description: There's too many of them on the main road to get anything done. <LINE> Make a dent and I'll see you right.

quests.title: Clearing Ekron
quests.description: Nobody's been out to Ekron since it turned, and the two who tried didn't come back. <LINE> Find out what's still in there. Bring screws, I'm short.

quests.title: The Mall Run
quests.description: Crossroads. In, out, don't get clever. <LINE> It's a good haul if you're quick and a bad way to go if you're not.

quests.title: Trainyard Scrap
quests.description: There's more metal sat in that yard than we could use in a year, and nobody's coming back for it. <LINE> Clear the ones wandering it and it's ours.
